Label: Pooled Site Group 1
Derivation: refer to SAP, Section 7.1 - if not pooled then SITEGR1=SITEID. If pooled, SITEGR1 will be 900

Label: Planned Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Numeric code for TRT01P which corresponds to the randomized dose

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
Derivation: TRT01A=TRT01P, i.e., no difference between actual and randomized treatment in this study.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Numeric code for TRT01A which corresponds to the randomized dose

Label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: SV.SVSTDTC when SV.VISITNUM=3, converted to SAS date

Label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: The date of final dose (from the CRF) is EX.EXENDTC on the subject's last EX record. If the date of final dose is missing for the subject and the subject discontinued after visit 3, use the date of discontinuation as the date of last dose. Convert the date to a SAS date.

Label: Cumulative Dose (as planned)
Derivation: For ARMN=0 or 1: CUMDOSE=TRT01PN*TRTDUR. --- For ARMN=2: CUMDOSE will be based on 54mg per day for the # of days subj was in 1st dosing interval (i.e., visit4date-TRTSTDT+1 if 1st interval completed, TRTEDT-TRTSTDT+1 if subj discontinued <=visit 4 and > visit 3), 81mg per day for the # of days subj was in 2nd dosing interval (i.e., visit12date-visit4date if 2nd interval completed, TRTEDT-visit4date if subj discontinued <= visit 12 and > visit 4), and 54mg per day for the # of days subj was in 3rd dosing interval (i.e., TRTEDT - visit12date if subj continued after visit 12).

Label: Pooled Age Group 1 (N)
Derivation: AGEGR1 = 1 if AGE <65. AGEGR1 = 2 if AGE 65-80. AGEGR1 = 3 if AGE >80.

Label: Safety Population Flag
Derivation: Y if ITTFL='Y' and TRTSDT ne missing. N otherwise

Label: Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
Derivation: Y if ARMCD ne ' '. N otherwise

Label: Efficacy Population Flag
Derivation: Y if SAFFL='Y AND subject has at least one record in QS for ADAS-Cog with VISITNUM>3 AND at least one record in QS for CIBIC+ with VISITNUM>3, N otherwise

Label: Completers of Week 8 Population Flag
Derivation: Y if subject has a SV.VISITNUM=8 and ENDDT >= date of visit 8, N otherwise

Label: Completers of Week 16 Population Flag
Derivation: Y if subject has a SV.VISITNUM=10 and ENDDT>=date of visit 10, N otherwise

Label: Completers of Week 24 Population Flag
Derivation: Y if subject has a SV.VISITNUM=12 and ENDDT>= date of visit 12 , N otherwise

Label: Did the Subject Discontinue the Study?
Discontinued due to AE?
Derivation: Y if DCREASCD='Adverse Event'. Null otherwise

Label: Pooled Baseline BMI Group 1
Derivation: BMIBLGR1=Normal if . < BMIBL <25. BMIBLGR1=Overweight if 25 <=BMIBL <30. BMIBLGR1=Obese if BMIBL >=30

Label: Date of Onset of Disease
Derivation: MH.MHSTDTC where MHCAT='PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS' converted to SAS date

Label: Duration of Disease (Months)
Derivation: number of months between VISIT1DT and DISONSET

Label: Date of Visit 1
Derivation: SV.SVSTDTC when SV.VISITNUM=1, converted to SAS date

Label: End of Trt Visit (Vis 12 or Early Term.)
Derivation: if DS.VISITNUM=13 where DSTERM='PROTCOL COMPLETED' then VISNUMEN=12, otherwise VISNUMEN=DS.VISITNUM where DSTERM='PROTCOL COMPLETED'

Label: Reason for Discontinuation
Derivation: Grouping of DCDECOD values to support summarizing study completion status and reason for discontinuation
